name: Naveen Rajan
comment: Verna Developers regularized our 14-acre KIADB industrial allotment in Dabaspet and secured absolute sale deeds in under 4 months. Exceptional government liaison.

name: Suresh K. Reddy
comment: When our Section 95 agricultural conversion was delayed for 18 months, Ajay and Gurunath resolved the Master Plan buffer zone conflict with BDA and secured the final DC conversion order.

name: Arunachalam & Family
comment: They traced 48 years of missing CITB allotment records for our grandfather's Kumara Park property and cleared the high court litigation amicably with full marketable title.
